predecessors.name: Byzantine Empire
predecessors.text: Manisa (Magnesia) and the Hermus valley, which 'fell to the Beylik of Saruhan in 1313'

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the Saruhan lands, absorbed 'as a province' after Mehmed I killed the last ruler

ledger.x: 1313: Saruhan Bey takes Manisa and founds the Saruhan beylik there.
1402: the beylik is restored under Orhan Bey.
1412: the Saruhan beylik ends; its land becomes the Ottoman sanjak of Sarukhan 'until the early years of the Republic of Turkey'.

wars.name: Bayezid I's overrunning of Saruhan
wars.outcome: Ottoman victory: the dynasty 'lasted for a first time until 1390, when Bayezid I overran the region'; Ottoman rule to 1402.

wars.name: Mehmed I's annexation of Saruhan
wars.outcome: Ottoman victory: Mehmed I killed Hızır, the last Saruhan ruler, and made the beylik an Ottoman province (1412 on the Sarukhanids page; 1410 on the Manisa page).

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for the Aegean beylik; its limits against Aydin, Karasi and Germiyan are approximate throughout.
